title: Returning to the vote: elections after the dictatorships
goal: Read how Latin American countries returned to elected government between 1979 and 1990, using ordering markers.
grammar: ordering markers: primero, después, finalmente, por un lado, además

items: I can list the countries that returned to elected government and the years.
I can contrast gradual transitions with those that followed a crisis.
I can say what the new civilian governments inherited.
I can put events and ideas in order with *primero*, *después*, *finalmente* and *por un lado … por otro lado*.
